errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва проценти, с диапазон от 0% до 82,6%
errors.evidence: The y-axis range extends to 100%, not 82.6%. The 82.6% is the highest value of a bar, not the axis maximum.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва секторите на икономиката, подредени по низходящ ред на процента, включен в отговорите
errors.evidence: The sectors are listed on the vertical axis (y-axis), not the horizontal axis (x-axis). The sectors are not sorted in descending order; they appear in arbitrary order.
Typo in the sector name: 'сторителството' should be 'строителство'.
The description omits the exact sector name for the lowest value (10.9%). It only mentions 'ИКТ' instead of the full label 'ИКТ, комуникации, софтуерен бизнес'.
The description does not explicitly state that the value labels are placed on the bars.
The description does not mention that the y-axis represents percentage values ranging from 0 to 100%.

errors.text_span: Наляво, в хоризонтална позиция са представени етикетите на секторите
errors.evidence: The sector labels are positioned horizontally but aligned to the left of the vertical axis, not in a horizontal axis position. The description incorrectly implies a horizontal axis for sectors.
The description does not mention that the sectors are ordered arbitrarily, not by descending percentage.
The phrase 'и други' is vague and not present in the figure or atom checklist. The figure lists all sectors explicitly.
